statement: Incognito mode hides your activity from Google completely. 🕵️
explanation: Nope! Incognito only hides history locally. Your ISP, employer & even Google can still see your activity!

statement: Deleting browsing history permanently erases all your data. 🗑️
explanation: Clearing local history doesn't delete Google's server-side copies. Check myactivity.google.com to see what they have!

statement: Google Maps works without internet using offline maps. 🗺️
explanation: TRUE! You can download area maps for offline use. Perfect for travel abroad where data roaming is expensive!

statement: Google Photos gives unlimited free storage forever. ☁️
explanation: This used to be true! Google ended unlimited free storage in June 2021. Now it's 15 GB shared across Gmail, Drive & Photos.

statement: YouTube listens to your conversations to show ads. 🎤
explanation: It feels like it! But it's just scary-good targeting using your search & watch history. No mic access needed.

statement: Chrome extensions can steal your passwords & data. 🔐
explanation: TRUE and very scary! Malicious extensions have actually stolen user data. Always check permissions carefully!

statement: Dark mode saves battery on every phone. 🌙
explanation: Only on OLED/AMOLED screens! LCD phones use the same power regardless of colours displayed.
